title: Action Card Schema v1
description: Upgraded schema for action cards emitted by the policy engine. Backward-compatible with v0 action cards (all new fields are optional, preserving existing CSV/JSONL outputs). New fields carry the diagnostic chain, confidence, playbook linkage, and expected impact needed to build merchant decision cards and improve LLM prompt grounding.

id.description: Unique action card identifier (act_<hex>). Foreign key into telemetry audit log.

run_id.description: Pipeline run identifier. Links to run_receipt.json.

policy_version.description: Version of the policy rules that produced this card.

action_type.description: The action the policy engine decided to take.

parameter_value.description: The parameter associated with the action (e.g. discount fraction 0.15 = 15%).

policy_passed.description: True if all hard constraints passed and an actionable offer was emitted.

expected_value_proxy.description: Rough proxy for expected monetary value of this action (discount_pct * m_proxy_value).

evidence.description: Key-value evidence dict used by the policy engine and passed to the LLM for grounding. May be a JSON string (v0 CSV) or an object.

constraints_applied.description: List of constraint check results. May be a JSON string (v0 CSV) or an array.

llm_explanation.description: Inline explanation stub (v0 field). Kept for backward compatibility; superseded by diagnostic_logic in v1.

rule_id.description: (v1) The playbook rule that produced this action card.

priority.description: (v1) Action priority rank within the rule's suggested_actions list. 1 = highest urgency.

automation_level.description: (v1) How much human review is required before this action executes.

confidence.description: (v1) Diagnostic confidence level derived from data completeness and signal strength.

validation_status.description: (v1) Whether this card should be treated as an actionable recommendation or a hypothesis requiring further checks.

diagnostic_logic.description: (v1) Condensed diagnostic chain attached to this action card for use in merchant decision card generation and LLM grounding.

pattern_detected.description: One-line name of the pattern that fired.

diagnosis_summary.description: Why this pattern fired for this specific entity (merchant-readable).

do_not_recommend.description: (v1) Action types explicitly forbidden for this card instance (inherited from the playbook).

expected_impact_proxy.description: (v1) Expected business outcome from this specific action card.
